name: (04) Thaumaturgy (Movement of the Mind) — 2 Intermediate — Repulse

system.description:
A gesture and a few words send a wave of force rolling outward, hurling threatening foes and heavy objects away from the thaumaturge.

You may Repulse anything in your line of sight, flinging objects up to 20 feet and pushing several at once. Against people, challenge your Mental Traits against each victim's Physical Traits as in mass combat; anyone who loses is thrown 20 feet away, even those grappling or biting you. If you Repulse an object into a victim, use your Mental Traits against their Physical Traits to strike for one level of lethal damage. Repulse is instant, so you must repeat it each turn you wish to move objects or people. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
